prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: New meaning graph/build modules over frozen source inputs. Reuse existing connectors and per-attempt accounting; preserve canonical IDs, uncertain aliases and provider lineage. Embedding batching is already implemented.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Checked analysis of selected view projections

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Typed mixed source and processed-document views
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: Checked DOCX/XLSX and processed PDF text participation in mixed source/document queries and semantic overlays. Existing standalone Office graphs are already implemented.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: New typed document-view bridge preserving original container hashes, XML origins and derived decoded-text offsets. Never fabricate binary-container UTF-8 offsets or collapse source spaces. Coordinate with existing media owners.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Git impact attribution and richer affected analysis
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: Modified-rename attribution, area classification and exact quoted explanations; richer supertype/override seed expansion and actual conflict/worktree triage remain beyond plain incoming reachability/path overlap.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: Independent impact-detail producer over existing verified Git/source/PR receipts. Keep deterministic exact identity matches separate from rename/ownership/affected candidates. Existing Git capture, history, owner suggestions, branch overlap and epoch selection are already implemented.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Managed assistant and Git-hook installation lifecycle
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: Reversible dry-run managed-block configuration install/uninstall, prompt/edit/session/statusline integrations and owned postcommit/checkout/merge/union-hook lifecycle.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: New installation-manifest subsystem and narrow host adapters with exact existing-byte/CAS ownership, conflict-safe merge and uninstall. Reuse existing runtime/query paths; no default hook, model or project execution.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Explicit external-source acquisition and graph database connectors
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: Native read-only PostgreSQL catalog acquisition; explicit Google shortcut export and URL/arxiv/PDF/social/video acquisition routes; explicit Neo4j/FalkorDB upsert. Existing local Office/media readers and generated Cypher do not supply these connectors.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: Split by connector, starting with a bounded read-only PostgreSQL catalog importer producing frozen typed artifacts. Use host-only endpoint/credential authority; query selection must never fetch. Coordinate URL/media work with its existing owners.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Self-hosted GitHub App and authorized review publication
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: HMAC webhook admission, installation authorization, deduplicated/superseding bounded review queues, controlled comment/capability-page publication and closed-PR discussion onboarding digest. Native GET PR reads are already present.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: Separate webhook/job/publication service around the existing GitHub reader and immutable source pipeline. Explicit write/deployment permissions belong to the host; development does not require publishing a comment or running fork source. Do not claim the proprietary hosted brain engine.

prioritizedRemainingScopes.title: Outcome and corroboration learning beyond authored currentness
prioritizedRemainingScopes.missingBehavior: Typed outcome events, corroboration, decay/scoring and explicit user-owned transcript mining. Existing notes, decisions and skill takeaway lifecycle do not implement this feedback layer.
prioritizedRemainingScopes.suggestedScope: New immutable source-bound feedback log and transparent ranking policy. Transcript import must be explicitly selected; never discover unrelated transcripts or substitute application learning for the central AgentMemory backend.
